description: [Data utilities] Get official macro figures for a country for research, market sizing or country-risk work. Use when a figure must be citable to an official source. Price: $0.005 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/macro-indicators

countries.description: Comma list of ISO2/ISO3 codes, up to 5 (e.g. DE,DK,USA)

indicators.description: Comma list of short names (gdp, gdp_per_capita, gdp_growth, inflation, unemployment, population, debt, current_account, exports, fdi, interest_rate) or WDI codes; default core set

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

name: macro_indicators
title: Country Macro Indicators (World Bank) ($0.005)
